cabin_to_lookout_s.note: needs 90-150 m of path, roughly 5-8 crossings of the island's 19 m long axis. A winding route can satisfy this; island size does not contradict it

island_circuit_s.note: even the window's FLOOR (45 s) needs 270 m, but one lap of the island is 48 m - 5.6 laps. A circuit that winds is no longer a circuit; one number here is wrong

notes: Necessary-condition check on a straight-line lower bound. A NOT_REACHABLE is real and needs a human ruling on which number is wrong. Every REACHABLE here is unfalsified by design - it means size does not contradict the window, not that the walk fits it.
